result.markdown:
# Grand Tunis Traffic Drop During Planned Transport Maintenance

- **Classification:** planned_maintenance
- **Root cause:** planned_maintenance at `LNK-TUN-01-C`
- **Confidence:** high (Outage perfectly matches scheduled maintenance window MW-0002 on LNK-TUN-01-C, with all alarms clearing upon window completion.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-07 02:30 to 2026-09-07 06:34
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-07 02:35
- **Affected:** S-TUN-005, S-TUN-015, S-TUN-016

## Summary

Routine transport network works executed under maintenance window MW-0002 on fiber link LNK-TUN-01-C caused expected short service interruptions.

Traffic, active users, and availability dropped on three sites in Grand Tunis for four hours during planned works.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-07 02:30: Traffic and availability drop begins on S-TUN-005, S-TUN-015, and S-TUN-016. [T1, ALR-0006]
- 2026-09-07 02:35: Planned maintenance MW-0002 starts on LNK-TUN-01-C. [T7, MW-0002]
- 2026-09-07 02:37: Critical LINK_LOS raised on LNK-TUN-01-C. [T5, ALM-000140]
- 2026-09-07 02:38: Critical SITE_DOWN alarms raised on S-TUN-015, S-TUN-016, and S-TUN-005. [T5, ALM-000141, ALM-000142, ALM-000143]
- 2026-09-07 06:25: LINK_LOS alarm clears on LNK-TUN-01-C. [T5, ALM-000140]
- 2026-09-07 06:34: Maintenance window MW-0002 ends with full service recovery. [T1, T7]

## Evidence

- Traffic, active users and availability dropped on S-TUN-005, S-TUN-015, and S-TUN-016 for 4 hours. [T1, ALR-0006]
- Sites S-TUN-005, S-TUN-015, and S-TUN-016 depend on fiber link LNK-TUN-01-C. [T2, T3, T4]
- A critical LINK_LOS occurred on LNK-TUN-01-C at 2026-09-07 02:37 during maintenance. [T5, T7, ALM-000140, MW-0002]
- SITE_DOWN alarms occurred on S-TUN-005, S-TUN-015, and S-TUN-016 following the link loss. [T5, ALM-000141, ALM-000142, ALM-000143]
- Routine transport network maintenance window MW-0002 covered LNK-TUN-01-C from 02:35 to 06:34. [T7, MW-0002]

## Inferences

- Software upgrade on CORE-UPF-01 occurred after maintenance started and did not cause the drop. [T6, CHG-2026-0021]

## Hypotheses

1. **planned_maintenance** at LNK-TUN-01-C: confirmed. The outage perfectly aligns with scheduled maintenance window MW-0002 on LNK-TUN-01-C with expected short interruptions. [T5, T7, ALM-000140, MW-0002]
2. **transport_failure** at LNK-TUN-01-C: rejected. The link loss was contained entirely within active planned maintenance window MW-0002. [T5, T7, MW-0002]
3. **bad_change** at CORE-UPF-01: rejected. Software upgrade CHG-2026-0021 occurred at 03:14, after the traffic drop and maintenance began. [T6, CHG-2026-0021]

## Ruled out

- ALM-000138: Minor fan failure on S-TUN-001 cleared well before the maintenance window and affected a different node.
- CHG-2026-0021: Software upgrade on CORE-UPF-01 happened after the event onset.

## Recommended actions

- Verify notification procedures so operations teams expect service interruptions during MW-0002.
- Review post-maintenance stability metrics on LNK-TUN-01-C.
